SELECT month, SUM (value) AS metricsValue, '${metricsName}' AS metricsName FROM ( SELECT month, SUM (value) AS value FROM bi_target_staff_setting tss LEFT JOIN bi_target_year ty ON tss.main_id=ty.id and ty.is_deleted= false WHERE tss.is_deleted= false AND ty.year=#{year} AND tss.metrics=#{metrics} GROUP BY month UNION ALL SELECT month, SUM (value) AS value FROM bi_target_shop_setting tss LEFT JOIN bi_target_year ty ON tss.main_id=ty.id and ty.is_deleted= false WHERE tss.is_deleted= false AND ty.year=#{year} AND tss.metrics=#{metrics} GROUP BY month UNION ALL SELECT month, SUM (value) AS value FROM bi_target_category_setting tcs LEFT JOIN bi_target_year ty ON tcs.main_id=ty.id and ty.is_deleted= false WHERE tcs.is_deleted= false AND ty.year=#{year} AND tcs.metrics=#{metrics} GROUP BY month UNION ALL SELECT month, SUM (value) AS value FROM bi_target_sku_setting tss LEFT JOIN bi_target_year ty ON tss.main_id=ty.id and ty.is_deleted= false WHERE tss.is_deleted= false AND ty.year=#{year} AND tss.metrics=#{metrics} GROUP BY month UNION ALL SELECT month, SUM (value) AS value FROM bi_target_new_product_setting tnp LEFT JOIN bi_target_year ty ON tnp.main_id=ty.id and ty.is_deleted= false WHERE tnp.is_deleted= false AND ty.year=#{year} AND tnp.metrics=#{metrics} GROUP BY month
) temp GROUP BY temp.month
